pages.text: $(l)The Resonating Stone structure is very rare and contains the Torcherino.$()$(br2)$(l)Chaos Shards can be mined without a Draconic Pickaxe$(); the Draconic tool is not required, though it may be gated as part of a set.
$(l)Use the Emptying Essentia Transfuser$() (Thaumcraft) $(l)instead of Essentia Cells + Cables$() to feed the Terraformer, avoiding cabling clutter.
$(l)The Superenchanted Flux-Infused Bow is highly effective in Chapter 5$() and remains viable until Vethea, where the Vethea Binding makes most weapons obsolete.
